  from __future__ import annotations
  from pydantic import BaseModel
  from enum import StrEnum
  from typing import Optional
  
  
  class Pet(BaseModel):
      kind: str
  
  
  class Kind(StrEnum):
      cat = 'cat'
  
  
  class Cat(Pet):
      kind: Kind
      lives: Optional[int] = None
